name: M4 Max (128GB): Llama 3.3 70B Q4_K_M decode tokens/sec
methodology: MLX-LM Metal backend, batch size 1, 512 token prompt, 128 token output, 4-bit quantization, 128GB unified memory
notes: M4 Max with 128GB unified memory at 546 GB/s. A 70B model at 4-bit requires ~35GB of weights, fitting comfortably in the 128GB unified pool. The 546 GB/s bandwidth yields ~18 tokens/sec for decode. The M4 Max can serve a 70B model that no 24GB discrete GPU can, but at lower speed than a discrete GPU with higher bandwidth.
